comment: The OSDF folders the tutorials read. 'path' is below the public namespace /fno4hic; each folder holds the .js_transfer_crc32c.json manifest of js_osdf.py, from which get_data.py lists and checks the files. 'include' picks files by glob (default: all). The tutorial sets live under tutorials/v2/ (data_recipes/make_v2.sh says how each was made) and are never overwritten: the OSDF caches keep a replaced file for a long time, so a changed set is a new version. The other sets are earlier examples.

oo_test.description: Three O+O events of the Pythonic workflow (oo_workflow.xml): the bulk hadrons (20 oversamples each) and the jet fragments.

hadron_read_test.description: One Au+Au 0-10% bulk_jet hadron file, for reader tests.

auau_jet_event.description: One Au+Au 0-10% jet event at 200 GeV: the hydro pair (arr, arr_bg), the particlize file, bulk_jet and jet_frag hadrons (no bulk_bg).

auau_hadrons_root.description: A Au+Au 0-10% jet campaign (pT-hat 10-40 GeV) converted to ROOT: 60 per-job files and the campaign file. Use --max-files to take a few.

auau_pair_mini.description: One 0-10% Au+Au background at 200 GeV with 5 jets (PYTHIA pTHat 30-40 GeV, hard partons at |y| < 0.6): the hydro pair (arr, arr_bg), the particlize file, bulk_jet and bulk_bg with correlated sampling (200 samples each, paired), jet_frag (20 per event), the ROOT files, the job record. The tutorials stream the hydro and fetch the hadron files.

auau_stats.description: 120 hadron-level 0-10% Au+Au events on 20 backgrounds, 40 in each pTHat window 10-20, 20-30, 30-50 GeV (hard partons at |y| < 0.6): bulk_jet (10 samples per event), bulk_bg (20 per background), jet_frag (10 per event), no positions; the ROOT files and the campaign file with the cross sections.

pp_ref.description: The vacuum (p+p) reference of auau_stats: 4500 events, 1500 in each pTHat window, the same parton cut, Matter's shower in vacuum and Colorless hadronization (10 fragmentations per event); HDF5 and ROOT.

oo_mini.description: 15 O+O events at 200 GeV (b < 3 fm) with initial-state radiation and a hard scattering (pTHat > 20 GeV): the hydro file, the particlize file, the bulk hadrons (50 samples per event) and the jet hadrons, the ROOT file.

derived.description: Summaries the tutorials read instead of a campaign: wake_observables.h5 and wake_hadrons.h5 of auau_pair_mini; extra_hard_hists.npz, campaign_events.npz and campaign_bulk.json of a minimum-bias Pb+Pb campaign with extra hard scatterings.
